name: Mumbai
desc: In Mumbai, where fast-paced urban life meets complex financial planning, Hari Kotian brings 25+ years of IRDAI-certified expertise. Get personalized doorstep consultations for life, health, and motor insurance tailored to your family's exact requirements.
it_focus: Custom term plans with global critical illness riders for corporate executives in BKC, Lower Parel, and Powai.
senior_focus: Dedicated doorstep assistance for senior citizens in Dadar, Matunga, and Borivali for claim settlement, pension planning, and policy documentation.
branch_dets: Seamless service coordination across Western, Central, and Harbour suburb insurer branches.

local_faqs.question: Do you help with health insurance claim rejections in Mumbai?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, claim recovery is our core specialty. We review rejected claims from any insurer and handle the appeal process with insurance ombudsman offices in Mumbai.

local_faqs.question: How quickly can I renew my car or health insurance in Mumbai?
local_faqs.answer: You can get instant quotes and digital policy issuance within 15 minutes, along with local advisor support for claim claims.
